title: IIF CEO on Rising Global Debt
summary: IIF CEO Tim Adams says debt in advanced economies will keep rising as governments borrow heavily and the private sector ramps up AI infrastructure investment. Summary from blurb only.

title: TikTok’s Chew and Microsoft’s Althoff Warn About Runaway AI Hype
summary: Tech leaders from TikTok and Microsoft warn the world may be overexcited about AI while overlooking its immaturity. They argue cybersecurity is a bigger near-term concern than AI advancing too fast.

title: Beijing Police Launch Probe Into Wealth Manager CreditEase
summary: Beijing police opened a criminal investigation into companies affiliated with wealth manager CreditEase over suspected illegal financial activities. Summary from blurb only.

title: Wall Street’s record-breaking trading streak set to cool
summary: Analysts forecast a sharp slowdown in Wall Street trading revenue when banks report Q3 results next week, after a bumper start to the year. Summary from blurb only.

title: The huge lurking leverage of AI hyperscalers
summary: While equity investors focus on a bright AI future, creditors are scrutinising hyperscaler liabilities such as data-centre leases. Summary from blurb only.

title: Bain’s Bridge Data Centres Seeks to Upsize Loan to $6.6 Billion
summary: Bain Capital-owned Bridge Data Centres is in talks with banks to more than double an existing loan to about $6.6 billion, one of the largest sector deals in Asia. Summary from blurb only.

title: DBS CEO Tan Says Market Is Repricing Risks on AI Financing
summary: DBS CEO Tan Su Shan says the market is repricing risks around the AI buildout, which could bring more discipline to financing. Summary from blurb only.

title: Guerra en Medio Oriente dominará agenda en reuniones del FMI y BM
summary: Los responsables financieros del mundo se reúnen en Bangkok bajo la sombra de la guerra en Medio Oriente, la mayor crisis de suministro energético y el alza de tasas, factores que amenazan el crecimiento global.

title: México es hoy el país más atractivo para la inversión en AL: CCE
summary: José Medina Mora, presidente del CCE, afirma que México es el mejor país para invertir en América Latina por su cercanía con EU y su distancia de los conflictos bélicos. Pide al gobierno garantizar seguridad jurídica y física, agua y energía.

title: Alza de tasas de largo plazo en EU puede encarecer el financiamiento para México, advierten
summary: BNP Paribas economist Pamela Díaz Loubet advierte que el alza de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de EU a 10 años puede encarecer el financiamiento de México. Las tasas mexicanas de largo plazo están expuestas a los movimientos del mercado estadounidense.

title: Amazon Is in Talks to Buy AI Startup Decart, WSJ Reports
summary: Amazon is reportedly in talks to acquire AI startup Decart in a deal that could be valued around $7 billion, per the Wall Street Journal.

title: Is AI Crowding Everyone Else Out of the Bond Market?
summary: Hyperscalers, data centers and chipmakers are borrowing hundreds of billions to fund the AI buildout, making it a major force in corporate credit. Rising concentration and complex financing raise the question of how much AI debt the market can absorb.

title: Cuesta comprar vivienda 15 años de sueldo íntegro
summary: La CDMX es la entidad más cara para comprar vivienda: un trabajador tendría que destinar su salario íntegro durante 15 años. Resumen basado solo en el adelanto.

title: La Negrita House / Estudio Palacios
summary: La Negrita House sits on the shores of Los Molinos Lake amid a dense eucalyptus forest, conceived as a peaceful retreat with its own microclimate.

title: Tokenización financiera: los cuatro obstáculos que debe superar para transformar los mercados, según el FMI
summary: Un análisis del FMI señala que la tokenización de activos financieros podría transformar la emisión, negociación y liquidación de operaciones en registros digitales programables, pero su potencial está lejos de materializarse. El artículo identifica cuatro obstáculos que debe superar.
